Build a Colosseum-style arena: a closed oval or octagonal ring wall about 20x16 studs outside, with a lower tier of arched openings all the way around and a second, set-back tier above with smaller openings. Sand color. Leave the arena floor open. 150-320 parts.
Constraints: footprint must fit within 22x18 studs; height at least 120 LDU (5 bricks); use at least 140 parts.
